title: UIP-1 Envelope Header
description: Signed header of a UIP-1 envelope. This is the only structure canonicalized with JCS (RFC 8785) before signing. The envelope body is not part of this schema: it is authenticated through body_hash.

v.description: Protocol version. Frozen at uip/1. A new cryptographic algorithm never changes this value.

id.description: Unique ULID of the envelope, Crockford base32, time-ordered.

from.description: DID of the signer. Its multicodec prefix fully determines the signature suite.

to.description: DID of the recipient. Absence means broadcast and is valid only with type=announce.

ts.description: Milliseconds since the UTC epoch at signing time.

ttl.description: Validity in milliseconds from ts. Bounded to 24 h so the replay store stays bounded.

content_type.description: Media type of the body (RFC 6838), or application/octet-stream when opaque.

body_hash.description: Hash of the body. An absent body hashes the empty string.

corr.description: id of the correlated envelope. Required for response and stream.

x.description: Extensions, keyed by reverse namespace. Covered by the signature. Receivers MUST ignore unrecognized keys. This is the only growth point of the header.

sig.description: Signature over UTF8("uip/1.envelope\n") || JCS(header without sig), base64url unpadded. Length varies by suite and MUST NOT be assumed: Ed25519 is 86 characters, a composite post-quantum signature is several thousand.

allOf.description: Every type except announce requires a recipient.
response and stream must correlate with the originating request.

did.description: did:key in multibase base58btc. The length range spans Ed25519 through post-quantum public keys; the multicodec prefix inside identifies the suite.

multihash.description: Registered hash algorithm prefix followed by the digest in base64url unpadded: sha256 (43 chars), sha384 (64), sha512 (86).

signature.description: base64url unpadded. Lower bound is Ed25519 (64 bytes); upper bound accommodates SLH-DSA (7856 bytes).
